result: Lean module CampaignFspHubbardProtected compiles cleanly under Lean 4.35.0 with pinned Mathlib (commit 56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679). All printed axioms are a subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} with zero sorry, admit, custom axioms, native_decide, or unsafe.
proof_boundary: Proves determinant pairing nonnegativity W >= 0 under the attractive spin-balanced and half-filled bipartite hypotheses, and proves exact negative product weights W < 0 for the doped ring and frustrated triangle witnesses outside protection, refuting unconditional determinant positivity.
